specs.locator: Filament Compatibility table › column 0.2 mm Nozzle (YES)
specs.quote: Material | 0.2 mm Nozzle … General PLA | YES … PETG | YES … PVA | YES … ABS | YES … ASA | YES … PC | YES
specs.conflict: Bambu wiki filament guide (generic, all Bambu nozzles) differs at 0.2 mm: «PVA, BVOH (Dry) | Not Compatible» and «PC | Not Recommended». The product page value is kept; adjudicate.

specs.source_title: Bambu Hotend - A1/A2 (Bambu Lab US store product page)
specs.locator: Filament Compatibility table › column 0.2 mm Nozzle (*①NO) › note ①
specs.quote: *① Filaments with carbon fiber, glass fiber, metal, or other inorganic particles are prone to clog a 0.2 mm nozzle.
specs.conflict: Bambu wiki filament guide differs at 0.2 mm: «PLA Metal | Compatible» (page row «Wood/Rock/Metal-filled PLA | *①NO»); TPU rows there say «Not Recommended» rather than not compatible.

specs.source_title: Bambu Hotend - A1/A2 (Bambu Lab US store product page)
specs.locator: Filament Compatibility table › column 0.4 mm Nozzle (YES / Recommended)
specs.quote: Bambu PLA-CF | *①NO | *②Recommended | YES | YES | Required … CF/GF Filaments from other brands | *①NO | Not Recommended | YES | YES | Required
specs.note: «CF/GF Filaments from other brands» is «Not Recommended» at 0.4 mm and is left out of both lists. Recommended at 0.4 mm hardened steel: Bambu PLA-CF, Bambu PETG-CF (note ②).

specs.source_title: Bambu Hotend - A1/A2 (Bambu Lab US store product page)
specs.locator: Filament Compatibility table › column 0.4 mm Nozzle × column Hardened Steel Required? (Optional)
specs.quote: Material | 0.2 mm Nozzle | 0.4 mm Nozzle | 0.6 mm Nozzle | 0.8 mm Nozzle | Hardened Steel Required? … PLA Sparkle | *①NO | YES | YES | YES | Optional
specs.conflict: Bambu wiki filament guide text says particle-filled filaments (PLA Marble, PLA Sparkle, PLA Glow) should not use a stainless steel nozzle, while its own table says PLA Marble «Not Required». The product page («Optional») is kept; adjudicate.

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Size › nozzle table › row 0.2 mm › Layer heights
specs.quote: Typically 0.05 mm to 0.12 mm (25-60% of nozzle diameter for optimal results).

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Size › nozzle table › row 0.4 mm › Layer heights
specs.quote: 0.1 mm to 0.3 mm (25-75% of nozzle diameter), with 0.2 mm being standard.
specs.note: The filament guide recommends 0.15–0.3 mm on a 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle for CF/GF and particle-filled filaments (a narrower, material-specific condition, not stored).
